overview: The Medford School Committee met to elect officers for 2022, receive district reports on COVID-19 protocols, secondary academic assessments, and English Learner programs, and consider several policy resolutions regarding subcommittees, public comment procedures, and student fees.

items.title: Election of School Committee Officers
items.summary: The committee elected Jenny Graham as vice chair and Paul Ruseau as secretary for 2022.

items.title: Good of the Order
items.summary: Members discussed creating formal orientation procedures for new committee members and reviewing a draft handbook of committee rules.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine bills, payrolls, and the regular meeting minutes from December 20, 2021.

items.title: Superintendent's Updates
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent reported on extreme cold weather preparations, vaccination clinics, kindergarten registration, and the launch of phase one of a district equity audit.

items.title: COVID-19 Operational Update
items.summary: Administration provided updates on surge testing numbers, vaccination clinics, upcoming transitions to five-day isolation guidelines, and long-term diagnostic testing plans.

items.title: Secondary Assessment Update
items.summary: Assistant Superintendent Dr. Peter Cushing presented progress on secondary testing schedules, NWEA MAP parent reporting, PSAT participation rates, and AP potential identification.

items.title: English Learners Department Update
items.summary: EL Director Paul Teixeira reviewed 2021 WIDA ACCESS data, noted an increase to 511 enrolled EL students, and announced a tech-literacy partnership with Tech Goes Home.

items.title: Resolution on Out-of-School Suspension Policy Implementation
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an administrative presentation and implementation data through December 31 on the district's out-of-school suspension policy.

items.title: Resolution on Before and After School Program Rates
items.summary: Approved a resolution asking administration to present proposed rates and capacity options for the before and after school program by March 1.

items.title: Resolution to Amend Policy BDE (Subcommittees)
items.summary: Referred a proposed policy amendment modifying subcommittee structures and agenda referral requirements to a Committee of the Whole meeting.

items.title: Resolution on Remediation and Credit Recovery Fees
items.summary: Tabled to January 24 a resolution proposing to eliminate summer remediation and credit recovery fees for vulnerable student subgroups.

items.title: Amendment to Policy BEDH (Public Written Comments)
items.summary: Approved an amendment to Policy BEDH to discontinue reading submitted written public comments aloud during meetings, directing instead that they be emailed to all members.

items.title: Condolences and Announcements
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to several local families for recent losses and extended congratulations to City Councillor Nicole Morell on the birth of her child.
